_documentation.purpose: Choose a preset, then add only the individual switches you want under overrides. Local layout/settings.json values override this global file.

preset.balanced: Keeps the presentation while deferring Japanese transcription and reducing file-poll work when the browser document is hidden.
preset.stable: Balanced plus immediate entrance and data-update states; avoids animation timing during live operation.
preset.minimal: Stable plus no rotating content panels and no image-readiness gate before revealing the source. Use when scene activation is the priority.

overrides.skip_entrance_animations: Immediately apply every supported layout entrance timeline's final state.
overrides.skip_update_animations: Immediately apply supported text, character, and layout update states instead of fading or moving them.
overrides.skip_content_rotation: Keep rotating presentation content on its initial panel.
overrides.skip_asset_readiness_wait: Reveal the browser source without waiting for all images to report ready; assets can appear a moment later.
overrides.skip_bracket_connector_animations: For Bee Bracket, render connector lines and set visibility in their resolved state instead of building SVG line-draw timelines.
overrides.lazy_japanese_transcription: Load and initialize the Japanese transcription dictionary only when Japanese text is actually encountered.
overrides.reduce_hidden_source_work: For file-based sources only, reduce program-state polling from 64ms to 1000ms while the browser document reports itself hidden.
